current_gap.character_limit_behavior: Only the first prefix is passed to rules; the row is then advanced and the full cell retained as truncated unknown.
current_gap.match_limit_behavior: Families are evaluated in order; returned matches are span-sorted only after collection. Later families can have missing candidates BEFORE the last returned span.
current_gap.existing_resume_behavior: Resume skips completed source rows. It does not reopen a truncated cell or recover cap-suppressed candidates in that cell.

recommended_minimum: Introduce a new scanner mode/version and new run manifest; preserve the currently running frozen output and fingerprint.
Replace per-cell match truncation with per-page write threshold. Enumerate each finite rule with a persisted rule_index and search_offset, preserving regex non-overlap phase.

Use bounded windows with a 65536-character core, 600-character left context and 9216-character right lookahead. Each finite rule scans from its true prior cursor, not a fresh overlapping finditer phase.
Only commit matches whose actual regex start precedes the core end. Complete matches can extend into the lookahead. Store absolute Unicode character offsets.
Commit one candidate page and its next cursor in one SQLite transaction. Time/disk budgets are checked between pages, including no-match pages; exceptions roll back both.
Deduplicate by source cell identity plus absolute start/end/category/subtype; retain deterministic existing literal-before-named family priority. Never key equality by the sensitive value.
A raw named match can yield multiple types: commit its labels together and permit at most 36 records over the page threshold, or add a label_index cursor if an exact hard page limit is required.
Scan the six PEM wrapper families with small delimiter state: pending opening offset, search offset and example-hint boolean. Never store the body; missing closing markers produce explicit gap spans.

For quoted named values outside the existing 4096-token rule, traverse quote/escape state in bounded blocks and retain an explicit finite-rule gap. Do not infer complete semantic typing from complete character traversal.

Retain a cell-level checkpoint until every selected field and rule completes; advance the table row only then. Existing whole-cell review records remain unknown/pending even when all rule passes finish.
Calculate cell HMAC incrementally over UTF-8 encoded Unicode chunks and store only the existing private digest. Do not persist raw text, carry buffers, keys or values.

recover_existing_truncated_cells.selection: Use prior cells.status=truncated and frozen source table/row/column references, not sensitivity-based sampling.
recover_existing_truncated_cells.restart_position: Re-read each selected whole cell from source and start rule_index=0, search_offset=0. This recovers both the >1MiB tail and missing rule-family hits in the already-read prefix.
recover_existing_truncated_cells.preserve_prior_runs: Write a separate recovery run referencing the previous manifest hashes; do not mutate old fingerprints or private DB status fields.
recover_existing_truncated_cells.consolidation: Prefer the complete new per-cell results for recovered cells, or apply explicit deterministic source-span-type deduplication. Do not blindly sum old and recovered rows.

coverage_accounting.cell_characters_read: Count unique cell characters once; overlaps and repeated family passes do not increase the source denominator.
coverage_accounting.rule_evaluations: Track rule cursors/pages separately; every character read by one family does not mean every family has run.
coverage_accounting.complete_lexical_visit: Only when every selected rule finishes every selected cell and no input tail remains.
coverage_accounting.semantic_status: All cells remain reviewable; unsupported formats, long named values and malformed envelopes are explicit gaps, not negatives.

remaining_limits: Prototype reuses frozen private rule helpers and duplicates a small adapter in /private/tmp for testing. Product integration is not implemented or deployed.
The long-named-value audit prototype starts from a supplied known quote offset. Automatic named-header discovery and persisted quote-state integration remain product work.

Regex buffers and pages are bounded, but current Arrow reads still materialize a full scalar. Use one-row/scalar decoding to avoid 64-cell copies; truly huge single-value memory remains an explicit separate decoding limit.

The finite maximum lookahead depends on the current regex definitions, including escaped quoted units that can consume 8192 characters. A rule change must update the bound and boundary tests together.
Synthetic checks establish mechanics for these cases, not correctness across every C#/Go/code syntax or complete semantic privacy detection.
Prototype collects final synthetic metadata for assertions; production exports should continue streaming SQLite rows rather than collecting every match in memory.

optional_measured_optimization.suggestion: A bounded per-process LRU around identifier-key taxonomy mapping in the new adapter, without changing taxonomy.py or exporting cache values.

boundary_correction.reported_case: PEM body page ends with dummy, next page continues suffix.
boundary_correction.root_cause: The example-word regex can use $, so a temporary chunk end was treated as end of the complete value.
boundary_correction.fix: Read 64 characters of right context before confirming an example marker; accept only keyword starts in the owned page interval. The optional leading delimiter is excluded from keyword-start ownership.
additional_regressions: dummy plus suffix across a page remains literal_candidate
dummy followed by an actual delimiter across a page remains placeholder_or_example
dummy starting exactly at the next page start remains detected
boundary_correction.bound: 64-character marker context covers the current finite example-word alternatives; change the bound with any future longer alternative.
